Take a request in, validated and normalized, or not at all

intake_request.Rd

The single door into the pure layer. Validation and the expiration conversion happen together because separating them would leave a way to get a valid request that was never converted, and the way to get the conversion wrong is to forget it.

Usage

intake_request(request)

Arguments

request

A named list, one request as described in the spec.

Value

A list with errors and request; request is NULL when errors is not empty.

Details

From here on every component — the diff, apply, before and after — speaks the value REDCap stores. The request speaks what a person means.
